yt_title: Got 500 saved reels? Here's how many are actually useful
caption:
Got 500 saved reels? Be honest.

I had 156 and never opened one again. SaveSort sorted them:
30 worth doing
10 flagged be careful
The rest said nothing without the video

How: download your Instagram data, tick Saved, drop the zip into SaveSort. Runs in your browser, nothing gets uploaded.

Want to know what's in yours? Sort yours free, link in bio.

#savedreels #instagramtips #productivity #organization #lifehacks
